model:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ART-DIRECTION MODEL SHEET for three evolved forms of the player fish in EVO: Living World. This is a NEW coherent anatomical design target for a 2D hand-painted underwater game. It is not a sprite atlas or UV template.

REFERENCE ROLES:
Image 1 shows the CURRENT IN-GAME RESULT and its problems. Preserve the recognizable creature family, right-facing side view, slate-gray / silver palette, pale gray fins and dark flowing contour. REDESIGN the bad anatomy rather than faithfully copying its flaws.
Image 2 is the approved painted fish STYLE reference, especially the delicate paint, broad silver-gray body planes and atmospheric dark ink.

LAYOUT:
One clean landscape model sheet, approximately 3:2 canvas, three full fish in three separate HORIZONTAL ROWS from top to bottom, all facing RIGHT, mouths CLOSED with only a natural thin mouth slit. Normal at top, stocky in middle, powerful-jawed predator at bottom. Full animals comfortably visible, no overlaps, consistent scale and side-view camera. No captions, lettering, labels, guide lines, numbers or decoration. Truly transparent background.

SHARED DESIGN:
All three must look like one living organism, with naturally joined skull, cheek, throat, torso and tail. Elegant side silhouettes; original premium hand-inked / hand-painted metroidvania game art, Hollow Knight-like clarity adapted to prehistoric fish. Mostly three to four large value groups, restrained subtle brush texture and carefully tapered dark contours. Cool slate-gray back and flank, a broad softly pale belly plane, warm gray fin membranes. Neutral soft light from above; no glossy wet realism or 3D.
A clearly readable ivory-and-dark eye that sits within a subtle socket and upper lid, no detached button. Replace the bright C-shaped gill ring in image 1 with ONE fine tapered gill slit integrated into the cheek; softly shade the back of the gill, no raised plate, no pale ring, no head/body separation line. Pectoral fins emerge from below that fold. No flat dark oval cheek spots. A few subtle fin rays. Quiet smooth skin; no scales, armor, camouflage, spots or elaborate patterns.

TOP / NORMAL:
A graceful compact fish, slight back arch, full but streamlined belly, organically tapering tail peduncle and small forked tail. Refine the existing normal fish's anatomy, keep its approachable character.

MIDDLE / STOCKY:
Make a convincingly muscular, compact, stout fish. Its torso is about 20 percent shorter and 30 percent deeper than the NORMAL torso. A FULL ROUNDED OVAL shoulder and belly with a continuous gently domed back. A robust head and thicker tail root fit the added mass. Absolutely no diamond-shaped vertical pancake, triangular mountain hump, dorsal spike in the body or stretched forehead. It must feel solid and heavy, and still obviously be a fish. The dorsal fin remains distinct from the rounded back silhouette.

BOTTOM / POWERFUL JAWS:
A purposeful predator of the SAME family with an elongated snout, broader muscular cheek, solid jaw joint and a substantial fleshy lower jaw that blends into the throat. A moderate elongation (roughly 1.5 to 1.7 times the normal snout), plus increased head depth and convincing muscle mass conveys biting strength. Its mouth is CLOSED in this sheet. The jaw is not a paper-thin sickle, bone blade, detached flap or huge red bag. Keep overall fish identity; do not make a shark, eel, crocodile or armored boss.

Make the new anatomy visibly more deliberate and cohesive than the reference. Prioritize forms and connections over extra texture. All poses are clean anatomical side views suitable for explaining a renderer redesign. No environmental background or ground shadow.
model_refinement: Edit this exact three-row fish model sheet. Preserve all three fish silhouettes, sizes, proportions, poses, fins, eyes, palette and painterly finish. Make ONE targeted anatomical cleanup on all three heads: paint over the broad pale C-shaped cheek/gill bands with continuous slate-gray skin matching the neighboring head and flank, so each cheek is an uninterrupted gently modeled volume. Retain only ONE thin, short, tapered dark gill slit behind each eye; the slit occupies only the central third of the former crescent height and softly disappears at its ends. No raised cheek panel, pale C-shaped band, full-height circular line, rim around the head or bright gill highlight. The pectoral fin still emerges naturally below the gill fold. All empty canvas must be fully transparent with no gray atmospheric halo, glow or background. No other changes, no text.
bite:
Create a coherent THREE-POSE ANIMATION MODEL SHEET of the POWERFUL-JAWED fish at the BOTTOM of this reference image. Use that exact fish design, palette, proportions, substantial lower jaw, cheek volume, eye, fins and tail in ALL THREE POSES. This is an artistic anatomy/animation reference, not a sprite atlas.

LAYOUT: Three complete full-body fish in three horizontal rows, facing RIGHT. Same body scale, camera, body position and neutral tail pose in every row. Top: CLOSED mouth. Middle: mouth HALF OPEN, roughly 18 degrees. Bottom: mouth at the strongest designed BITE opening, roughly 35 to 40 degrees. No large lunge or body bend; isolate jaw articulation. Entire fish visible with comfortable margin; no overlaps. No lettering, numbers, captions, labels, guide lines or borders. True transparent background without atmospheric halos or ground shadows.

CRITICAL ANATOMY: The lower jaw stays thick and fleshy, especially near the rear hinge where it integrates into the throat. It rotates naturally from that joint, with its root cradled under the cheek. A tapered, muscular lower lip/chin continues into the neck; no thin white sickle, hanging blade or disconnected flap. The head and upper snout retain volume. The broad cheek belongs to the same skin surface as the body. A small subtle dark gill slit, no pale C-shaped ring or separate outlined cheek panel.

MOUTH DEPTH: The open mouth must look like a recessed DARK HOLE. Near-black plum charcoal in the throat and center, a NARROW softly curved muted mauve palate surface immediately below the upper lip, and a small subdued lower lining immediately above the lower jaw. The pale external skin stays outside. Small teeth grow from the lips, roughly three upper and two lower teeth. Most visible mouth area remains deep dark negative space, not bright red interior.
NO red triangular membrane spanning the whole opening, no stretched pink bag, no straight back wall, no curtain, no broad illuminated flesh sheet, no glowing mouth, no tongue, no horror or gore. The new pose must show how a muscular jaw can open while preserving an integrated throat, cheek and skull.

STYLE: Match the reference exactly: premium hand-painted and hand-inked 2D metroidvania game art, softly modeled slate-gray / silver skin, pale belly, warm gray fins, restrained brush texture, dark organic contour, clear readable broad shapes. Avoid photorealism or 3D.
